Actually, to give the final blow to all of this uploading, I'm bringing this. The newer, revisited version of the tank, exclusive from Fanza so far.

Slightly different from the older RAW, https://e-hentai.org/g/1031675/2a475f18d9/ are:

- Higher quality. And I mean it!! Those shota shitters are 190% juicier and more fuckable 💢💢!
- Himezaki Asuka (the one from the cover) having a different smile. The cover is also different.
- 2 cute arts: one being Yuki, the tsundere femboy with bunny ears. The other one is Chisato, the feminine little brother that learned how to cum thanks to onii-chan! [gonna be honest, I didn't knew he has pink hair, what the hell 💀💀]
- This compensates the absence of the 2 fanarts for Nishio and Takeru (in crossdress) from the older RAW
- A content list, with Mako (cute tanned shota) in it!
- Censor is more opaque (but not fully) than the older RAW
- Different colophon

And probably other slight changes I didn't noticed.

Anyway, this being a better version of the tankoubon (especially in quality) doesn't mean that the older RAW should be expunged. If anything, both deserve to stay.
